new_findings_today.title: `| NakshIQ | NakshIQ` title stutter on the new /luxury surface (hub + detail) and /festivals detail pages
new_findings_today.detail: The two new public surfaces shipped 2026-05-23 (SW bumps v44 /festivals detail pages, v46 /luxury hub + per-experience detail, v47 /luxury hero videos) emit a doubled brand suffix in their <title> tag. Confirmed STUTTER on: /en/luxury and /hi/luxury hub ('Ultra-luxury India trips — royal trains, palace hotels, iconic stays | NakshIQ | NakshIQ'); /en/luxury/aman-i-khas-ranthambore, /en/luxury/amanbagh-alwar, /hi/luxury/aman-i-khas-ranthambore ('Aman-i-Khas — iconic stay | NakshIQ | NakshIQ'); /en/festivals/pushkar-camel-fair, /en/festivals/dev-deepawali, /en/festivals/maha-shivaratri-varanasi, /hi/festivals/pushkar-camel-fair, /hi/festivals/dev-deepawali ('... in Varanasi | NakshIQ | NakshIQ'). NOT affected: the /en/festivals and /hi/festivals hub pages ('Festivals & Events — 183 Festivals Across India | NakshIQ' — single, correct suffix), destination pages, month sub-routes, and the landing page (all clean — Section D 0/12). This is the SAME bug class as the previously-fixed DEEP-Phase2-D1: the new route components hard-code a ' | NakshIQ' suffix in their own title string while the Next.js root-layout title template ALSO appends ' | NakshIQ', so the suffix doubles. The /festivals hub avoids it (it uses the template correctly), proving the fix pattern is known in the codebase and the detail/luxury routes simply diverged from it. Scope is sizable: the /luxury hub + ~30 EN + ~30 HI detail pages and ~331 EN + ~331 HI /festivals/[slug] detail pages — roughly 720+ indexable URLs carry a malformed title. No user-facing breakage (every page is HTTP 200 and renders fine) but it degrades SERP/AI-answer presentation on a brand-new, monetisation-adjacent surface (/luxury).
new_findings_today.evidence: section-D-new-surfaces.csv + the Section D-supplement probe block: 11 of 13 new-surface URLs probed (every /luxury URL + every /festivals/[slug] detail URL, en and hi) match /NakshIQ\s*\|\s*NakshIQ/; the 2 exceptions are the /en/festivals and /hi/festivals hubs. Chrome MCP tab title for /en/luxury/aman-i-khas-ranthambore independently rendered 'Aman-i-Khas — iconic stay | NakshIQ | NakshIQ'. Standard Section D 12-URL sample (landing + 10 destinations + old-goa/may) all 0 stutter — section-D-seo.csv.
new_findings_today.recommendation: In the /luxury and /festivals/[slug] route metadata, stop hard-coding the ' | NakshIQ' suffix and rely on the root-layout title template (or set the page title via `title.absolute` consistently with how the /festivals hub does it). One template fix clears all ~720+ URLs. Medium severity — SEO defect on a new revenue-adjacent surface; schedule ahead of the next SEO sweep, and add /luxury + /festivals/[slug] sample URLs to the Section D title-stutter check so future regressions on these surfaces are caught.
